reference: Fixed Symfony Console7.4.0 QuestionHelper::autocomplete/readInput, SymfonyQuestionHelper and ConsoleSectionOutput

native_cancel_cleanup.method: Observe after handle_command returns while the process keeps the controlling PTY alive; then release and verify exit

mechanism: One inherited stdin lease/key-event loop; plain input and completion have distinct readers like the source
No initial selected candidate; arrows select and cycle, Tab accepts, first backspace clears a candidate and later backspace deletes entered text
Accepted full choice and current completion input remain separate, including comma-separated multi-choice
Source cursor clear/save/restore writes and hl formatter style use the selected output and preserve source section state
Completion takes precedence when multiline and completion are both set
native_adaptations: Reference TTY CRLF is normalized to LF before comparing redirected native stdout. The 29 completion/choice output byte sequences are then identical.
Plain multiline keeps existing nonblocking async editing rather than canonical OS echo. Its four cases compare answer and section state, not falsely identical echo bytes.
Existing native EOF keys and async cancellation/error/default rules are preserved; no new stream dispatcher, unsafe pointer or dependency.

The initial restoration probe queried a detached PTY after process exit and failed ENOTTY. The corrected probe checks full original termios while the completed command session is still alive; it passes.
remaining: Nested styles/component SDK and arbitrary output sinks are separate remaining chapter work
